objects.name: Dragonfly 2.0
objects.description: [Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074) is a suspected Russian group that has targeted government entities and multiple U.S. critical infrastructure sectors since at least December 2015. (Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A) (Citation: Symantec Dragonfly Sept 2017) There is debate over the extent of overlap between [Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074) and [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035), but there is sufficient evidence to lead to these being tracked as two separate groups. (Citation: Fortune Dragonfly 2.0 Sept 2017)(Citation: Dragos DYMALLOY )
objects.description_fa: [Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074) یک گروه مشکوک روسی است که نهادهای دولتی و چندین بخش زیرساخت حیاتی ایالات متحده را حداقل از دسامبر 2015 هدف قرار داده است. 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074) و [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035)، اما شواهد کافی وجود دارد که منجر به ردیابی این دو به عنوان دو گروه جداگانه شود.
